11705 Caleigh Anne Dr, Belton, TX 76513

This stunning home has it all:
✔️ Spacious owner’s suite with garden tub & walk-in closets in every bedroom
✔️ Granite countertops, kitchen island, & breakfast bar
✔️ Cozy wood-burning fireplace & pool views from the living and dining rooms

Step outside to your dream backyard:
🌳 Covered patio with BBQ space, fridge, sink, & fireplace
🌊 In-ground pool with lights, garden lighting, & cool decking
🚗 Extra 16 x 28 ft garage with 9-ft ceilings

✨ Updates Galore: New roof, gutters, insulated garage doors, water heater, & pool coupling!

📍 Move-in ready with fridge, washer/dryer, floating shelves, surround sound, & security cameras all included!
